title: The Sun Turns 4 Million Tons of Itself Into Energy Every Second

scenes.text: Every second, the Sun destroys four million tons of itself.
That mass becomes pure energy, including the sunlight warming your face right now.
It isn't burning. It's fusing hydrogen, and some of the mass turns directly into light.
The Sun fuses about 600 million tons of hydrogen every second.
And it has been doing this for 4.6 billion years.
Four million tons a second, and it's barely made a dent.

description:
The Sun converts about 4 million tons of matter into energy every second.
It does it by fusing roughly 600 million tons of hydrogen per second, and it has been doing so for about 4.6 billion years.
What would you use that much energy for? Comment below.
thumbnail_text: THE SUN LOSES 4 MILLION TONS A SECOND
first_comment: The Sun is shrinking by that much every second and will still shine for billions of years. Does that comfort you or scare you?
